profile.headline: Software person
profile.summary:
Performance oriented data technologist capable of writing code and understanding how it runs in complex production environment. I get very excited at when solving challenging problem around performance and BIG data. I enjoy analyzing behavior of application to identify its bottleneck and optimize its performance. I am capable of wearing many different hats. As an site reliability engineer, I have built and optimized a large scale, high available infrastructure with 99.99+% uptime over 3+ years. As an software engineer, I have wrote a robust and high performance traffic generator that can sustain 50k TCP connections from a single process. As a team lead, I have led a team to cover operation of a SaS product with multi-million users.  

Genuinely passionate about technology. I constantly improve my skill set to make my team and company more productive.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform
positions.description: Worked on backend platform that manages Endpoint. Wrote many Python and Go code and  focussed on scalability and performance challenges. Implemented a traffic simulator in Go that mimics connection from 100k endpoints. Wrote many architecture documents and diagrams to provide unified understanding and direction for the team.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - DevOps
positions.description: Worked with a team of talented engineers and data scientists to develop innovative security products that provides endpoint protection. The team constantly collaborate to make things better through ongoing research. The role involved around developing service component that provides high  performance, scalability, and reliability using Python and Go.

positions.title: Infrastructure Architect
positions.description: Served as a Infrastructure Architect at a state institute specialized in distance learning. The primary project was migrating university's in-house infrastructure(consisting of several hundreds of machines) onto Amazon Web Service platform. I implemented the Virtual Private Cloud environment from scratch and drafted migration strategy framework for rebuilding each service on AWS. While observing the workflow of engineers, I wrote a custom EC2 bootstrapping web UI using Amazon API and Puppet that automatically build out EC2 host with necessary configurations. Authored visual diagrams capturing infrastructure layout to have every engineers on the same page.

positions.title: Devops Lead
positions.description: Responsible for running and maintaining high availability infrastructure with geographic redundancy. Enhanced web applications performance with query optimization. Setup foundation for Redhat Enterprise Linux migration. Wrote many RPM spec files from scratch to automate product deployment on Redhat Enterprise Linux platform. Created CLI utilities handling daily administrative operations for jr staffs.

positions.title: Senior Systems Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for leading system engineering team that operates a large scale high available LAMP stack with +99.99% uptime. Constantly perform system monitoring, performance analysis and bottleneck detection, and implement appropriate solution.

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description: Migrated physical Linux environment to Xen based virtual environment. Enhance organization's mail functionality by implementing Zimbra suite. Improved mail reliability by implementing multiple mail gateways and reduced Spam rate by using RTBL and Spam Assassin.
